product_overview: Astra is an in-app research assistant for chatting, drafting academic prompts, and running deep research conversations with streamed responses and citations. Users can also review generated document artifacts, approve certain actions, and manage their authenticated workspace experience.
core_goals: Sign in and access the authenticated Astra experience
Start and continue research chats with streamed AI responses
Use slash commands to generate academic and research-oriented prompts
Request deep research and review the resulting plan and cited synthesis
Review, copy, regenerate, and manage generated artifacts within threads
Approve or reject sensitive tool actions before they execute

features.name: Clerk authentication
features.description: Users can sign in with email and password to enter the authenticated product area.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See redirection to /app

features.name: Astra streaming chat
features.description: Users can send research questions to Astra and watch the answer stream in real time, then copy or regenerate the response after it finishes.
user_flows: Navigate to /app -> Type a message in the composer -> Send the message -> See the user message appear -> See the assistant answer stream in token by token -> See the completed answer with copy and regenerate actions
Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Start streaming a response -> Choose to stop the response mid-stream -> See the partial answer remain -> See the composer return to ready state
Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Send the same prompt again using regenerate -> See a new assistant turn begin with the same user prompt -> See a fresh streamed answer

features.name: Slash command menu
features.description: Users can open a slash-command menu and select academic, research, or workspace commands, including deep research mode.
user_flows: Navigate to /app -> Type / in the composer -> See a grouped menu of available commands -> Filter the list by continuing to type -> Select a command -> See the command inserted into the composer
Navigate to /app -> Type /deep in the composer -> Select Deep research -> See a deep mode chip attached to the composer -> Enter a research question

features.name: Deep research plan and cited synthesis
features.description: Users can request deep research, review a proposed research plan, approve or reject the plan, and then receive a cited synthesis with sources.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Send a deep research question -> See a research plan card with a proposed plan and sub-questions -> Approve the plan -> See the research process continue -> See a final answer with inline citation markers and a sources toggle

Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Send a deep research question -> See a research plan card with a proposed plan and sub-questions -> Reject the plan -> See the research request stop without starting research

features.name: Destructive tool approval
features.description: Users must approve or reject destructive actions, such as deleting an artifact, before the action runs.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Ask Astra to delete an existing artifact -> See an approval card with approve and reject actions -> Approve the request -> See confirmation that the artifact was deleted
Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Ask Astra to delete an existing artifact -> See an approval card with approve and reject actions -> Reject the request -> See the action cancel without deletion

features.name: Artifacts and sources panel
features.description: Users can view generated document artifacts inline in a thread and inspect cited sources in a collapsible panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Ask Astra to create a short document -> See a document artifact card appear in the thread -> Reload the page -> See the artifact card still present
Navigate to /app/threads/[threadId] -> Open a response that includes citations -> Expand the sources panel -> See numbered source entries that match the inline citation markers

features.name: Onboarding
features.description: New authenticated users can complete first-run onboarding before entering the main product area.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Complete the onboarding flow -> Continue into the app experience

features.name: Workspace browsing
features.description: Users can access the workspace area to review available workspaces and linked artifacts.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/workspaces -> Review the list of workspaces -> Open a workspace-related artifact from the available content

features.name: Settings
features.description: Users can open the settings hub to manage account, appearance, security, and usage or billing-related preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/settings -> Review available settings sections -> Open the section needed for account, appearance, security, or usage and billing preferences

features.name: Explore feed
features.description: Users can browse the discovery feed to explore research content and ideas.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/explore -> Review the discovery feed -> Open content of interest for further exploration

features.name: Thread list
features.description: Users can review their existing Astra chat threads and open a conversation to continue working.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/threads -> Review the list of saved threads -> Open a thread -> Continue the conversation from the selected thread

tech_stack: Mastra agent runtime (@mastra/client-js) streamed over /mastra-api proxy
TanStack Query (Eden Treaty client to Elysia API)
Radix UI + shadcn + Tailwind, streamdown markdown renderer

routes.description: Public landing page with sign-in entry
Authenticated product home; new Astra chat composer opens here
List of the user's Astra chat threads
A single Astra chat thread (streaming chat, slash commands, deep research, HITL cards, artifacts, sources)
Server proxy that streams to the Mastra agent runtime

features.name: Astra streaming chat
features.description: Send a message to the Astra agent and receive a token-by-token streamed answer; Stop control while streaming; copy and regenerate actions after completion
user_interactions: Type a message in the composer and press Enter to send
See the user message bubble appear and the assistant answer stream in
See "Astra sedang berpikir…" / "Astra sedang menyusun jawaban…" indicator and a Stop button while streaming
Click Stop to halt streaming mid-answer (partial text remains, no error overlay)
Click the regenerate (circular arrow) icon to re-answer without duplicating the user message
Click the copy icon to copy the answer
Reload the page mid-stream and have the in-progress answer resume/complete

features.name: Slash command menu
features.description: Typing "/" opens a command menu of 10 academic/research/workspace commands; selecting /deep enters deep-research mode
user_interactions: Type "/" to open the command menu grouped into Tulis Akademik, Rancang Riset, Workspace
See 10 commands (/paraphrase, /expand, /summarize, /outline, /research-question, /methodology, /literature-review, /deep, /artifact, /workspace)
Continue typing to filter and select a command
Select Deep research to attach a "deep" mode chip to the composer

features.name: Deep research with plan-gate HITL
features.description: /deep produces a "Rencana riset" approval card (plan + sub-questions) that must be approved before the literature search and cited synthesis run
user_interactions: Send a /deep research question
See a "Rencana riset" card with a prose plan, a bullet list of sub-questions, and Setujui / Tolak buttons
Click Setujui to run the research process trace (Menelaah literatur, Mencari bukti tandingan, Memverifikasi sitasi, Menulis sintesis)
Click Tolak to cancel without researching
See a final answer with inline citation markers [1], [2] and an "N sumber" sources toggle

api_calls.endpoint: /mastra-api (deep-research workflow stream, suspend/resume on plan approval)

features.name: Destructive tool approval (HITL)
features.description: Requests to delete an artifact surface an approval card ending "Setujui untuk menjalankan." that must be approved before deletion
user_interactions: Ask the agent to delete an existing artifact
See an approval card with Setujui / Tolak buttons
Click Setujui to confirm deletion (agent replies "Sudah dihapus", card removed)

features.name: Artifacts and sources panel
features.description: Document artifact cards render inline in the thread and survive refresh; cited sources render in a collapsible "N sumber" panel with bracketed citation numbers
user_interactions: Ask Astra to create a short document; approve in conversation if prompted
See a document artifact card (title + "Dokumen") in the thread
Reload and confirm the artifact card persists
Expand the "N sumber" toggle to see numbered sources [1], [2] matching the prose

features.name: Clerk authentication
features.description: Sign in with email and password via Clerk before reaching the authenticated product area
user_interactions: Open the landing page and click the sign-in entry
Fill email and password in the Clerk form and submit
Get redirected to /app on success

known_limitations.issue: Test account is plan admin (unlimited credits); quota/billing-block flows cannot be exercised
known_limitations.impact: Billing/quota UI states are out of scope for automated assertions

known_limitations.issue: Citation numbers, credit ledger rows, and exact truncation length are DB-level facts not visible in the UI
known_limitations.impact: These are manual DB checks, not UI assertions
TC7 / TC14 are best-effort; mark inconclusive if the mid-stream window is missed
